questions.question:
The following sentence has been divided into four parts. Identify the part that contains an error.

(A) Four divided by / (B) two is coming / (C) out to / (D) be two.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect use of the phrase "**is coming**" in part (B).
 
• Since the sentence discusses a** mathematical fact**, it should use the **simple present tense.**
 
• The correct phrase should be "**is**" instead of "**is coming**," ensuring **grammatical accuracy and clarity.**
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part B** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **B**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Four divided by two **is** two."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **A: "Four divided by" ** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **C: "out to" ** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **D: "be two." ** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Many soldiers marched in ________ at the international border
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2 **i.e. **uniform**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**Uniform**" is a standard set of clothing worn by members of an organization while participating in that organization's activity, particularly pertinent to the military.
 
• Using "**uniform**" conveys the idea that the soldiers were dressed in a standardized manner, which is typical for soldiers.
 
• The term "**dress**" generally refers to attire but doesn't specifically denote the standardized clothing for soldiers.
 
• "**Fabric**" and "**clothes**" are too general and do not convey the idea of a standardized, cohesive appearance expected from soldiers.

Therefore, the **correct answer **is- **uniform**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: dress:** While "dress" can refer to clothing, it does not specifically imply the standardized attire of soldiers.
 
• **Option 3: fabric:** "Fabric" refers to material used to make clothes but does not imply a completed garment or the standard attire of soldiers.
 
• **Option 4: clothes: **"Clothes" are too general and do not capture the formal, standardized aspect of a military uniform.

questions.question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

This scripture / has been /translated in / seventy languages.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Option 4 i.e. **translated in.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct preposition to use with "**translated**" should be "**into**" instead of "**in**."
 
• **"Translated into"** is the appropriate phrase to indicate that something has been changed from one language to another.
 
• Using **"translated in"** is incorrect as it implies the act of translation occurred within a specific language, which doesn't make sense in this context.
 
• The revised sentence should read: *"This scripture has been **translated into** seventy languages."*

Therefore, the correct answer is- **translated in.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: seventy languages:** This part correctly specifies the number of languages into which the scripture has been translated.
 
• **Option 2: This scripture: **This part correctly introduces the subject of the sentence.
 
• **Option 3: has been: **This part is correct and sets up the passive voice construction appropriately.

• **Option 3: A; Ø:** The absence of "a" before "pair of powered glasses" makes the sentence incorrect.
